tagline: International Association for Inland Waterway Transport Safety and Regulation
hero_kpi_rationale: Reflects the mobilization of a pan-European network of experts and members around inland waterway safety and regulation. The annual congress is the focal point of the organization's collective engagement and international collaboration.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the IVR annual congress, representing engagement and mobilization of the pan-European network.
kpis.description: The IVR annual congress brings together experts, members and industry partners from the European inland waterway transport sector around safety, regulation and sustainability issues.
kpis.signal: 225 participants from 11 countries at the 2024 congress (May 15-17 in Frankfurt)

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the first loss prevention colloquium organized by IVR in Antwerp.
kpis.description: New event format organized by the IVR loss prevention committee, bringing together insurers, contractors, regulators and technical experts.
kpis.signal: 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany at the first colloquium (November 4, 2024)

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, advanced automation technologies or AI-related initiatives in the 2024 report. The organization focuses on collaboration, regulation and traditional sustainability initiatives.
evidence: No reference to AI, APIs, predictive models or automation tools
Mentions of digitalization in a regulatory context (CESNI standards) without an AI dimension
